source_lines_after.28: A circuit family is a sequence $(C_n)$ with exactly $n$ inputs at length $n$. It recognizes $L$ if $C_n(x)=1$ exactly when $x$ belongs to $L$ for every $n$-bit $x$. P/poly contains exactly the languages recognized by families with polynomial size; no algorithm that constructs $C_n$ from $n$ is required.
